Violins, points and boxes of one feature

Source: R/distribution_plots.R
violin_panel.Rd

Violins, points and boxes of one feature

Usage

violin_panel(
  d,
  pts,
  group_cols,
  flip,
  box,
  box.width,
  pt.size,
  alpha,
  adjust,
  layer_fun,
  seed,
  annotate,
  top = NA_real_,
  split_side = if (flip) "right" else "top"
)

Arguments

d

Long table of one feature (distribution_data())

pts

Rows of `d` drawn as points

group_cols

Colours named by group

flip

Whether violins are horizontal

box, box.width, pt.size, alpha, adjust, seed

As in VlnPlot_bioToolkit

layer_fun

Function rasterizing the point layer, or not

annotate

Whether to print the % of cells above 0 per group

top

Top of the value axis on the scale it is drawn on (log10 for a log axis), where violins and boxes are cut; NA for none

split_side

Side of the split.by block names: "top" / "bottom" (vertical violins) or "left" / "right" (horizontal)

Value

A ggplot object (no scales for the value axis yet)
